question: What three disciplines are integrated within nursing informatics?

options.A: Nursing science, computer science, and information science
options.C: Nursing practice, health economics, and data entry
options.D: Biological science, physical science, and information technology

explanation: Nursing informatics is formally defined as the integration of nursing science, computer science, and information science to manage health data and knowledge. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: How does nursing informatics primarily enhance patient safety in clinical settings?

options.A: By increasing manual paperwork and documentation time
options.B: By reducing medication errors through electronic prescribing and barcoding
options.C: By replacing registered nurses with automated machines
options.D: By eliminating the need for multidisciplinary healthcare teams

explanation: Informatics improves patient safety by implementing electronic tools like barcoding and electronic prescribing to minimize medication errors. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: What is the primary focus of clinical nursing informatics?

options.A: Managing hospital financial budgets and payroll
options.B: Direct patient care and the delivery of nursing services
options.C: Writing nursing school curricula and lecture notes
options.D: Conducting laboratory bench research on diseases

explanation: Clinical nursing informatics centers specifically on patient care delivery, clinical workflows, and improving bedside outcomes. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: How do clinical decision support systems (CDSS) assist nurses?

options.A: By alerting nurses to critical lab values and potential drug interactions
options.B: By automatically scheduling nursing staff shifts and leave
options.C: By ordering hospital supplies and medical equipment
options.D: By grading nursing student clinical evaluation forms

explanation: CDSS tools provide alerts and prompts regarding critical data, allergies, and drug interactions to protect patient safety. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: What is a key use of nursing administration and leadership informatics?

options.A: Monitoring staffing levels, patient acuity, and budget expenditures
options.B: Diagnosing complex medical diseases at the bedside
options.C: Teaching undergraduate nursing students clinical procedures
options.D: Developing consumer-facing health apps for patients

explanation: Nurse leaders use administrative informatics to manage resources, monitor staffing, track patient acuity, and analyze budgets. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: How does administrative informatics help resource-constrained healthcare facilities?

options.A: By tracking medical inventory and preventing stock-outs of consumables
options.B: By eliminating the need for any administrative staff
options.D: By reducing the salary of healthcare workers

explanation: Inventory tracking tools within administrative informatics help manage supplies and prevent critical shortages of medical consumables. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: Which of the following is a tool used in nursing education informatics?

options.A: Learning Management Systems (LMS) and virtual simulations
options.C: Patient bed allocation and scheduling software
options.D: Surgical laser equipment and sterilization autoclaves

explanation: LMS platforms and virtual simulations are core educational informatics tools used to deliver and manage nursing curricula. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: Why is educational informatics particularly beneficial for nursing students in settings with limited clinical space?

options.A: It provides alternative learning pathways through virtual patients and e-learning modules
options.B: It allows students to bypass clinical rotations entirely
options.C: It removes the need for nursing examinations
options.D: It replaces clinical instructors with computers

explanation: Virtual patients and e-learning modules offer valuable clinical reasoning practice when physical placement sites are overcrowded. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: What is the primary purpose of nursing research informatics?

options.A: To advance nursing science and evidence-based practice through data analysis
options.B: To manage daily hospital staff attendance and shifts
options.C: To teach basic nursing skills to first-year students
options.D: To handle patient billing and health insurance claims

explanation: Research informatics supports data collection, analysis, and retrieval to advance scientific knowledge and evidence-based nursing practice. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: Why are standardized nursing languages important in research informatics?

options.A: They allow researchers to compare clinical data easily across different studies and populations
options.B: They make medical charts completely unreadable to other professionals
options.C: They eliminate the need for statistical data analysis software
options.D: They replace the need for patient consent in clinical trials

explanation: Standardized languages ensure consistency, making it possible to aggregate and compare nursing data across various studies. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: What is the main focus of consumer health informatics?

options.A: Empowering patients to manage their health using patient-facing technologies
options.B: Managing hospital financial accounts and procurement
options.C: Writing complex algorithms for hospital mainframe computers
options.D: Instructing nursing students in clinical laboratory skills

explanation: Consumer health informatics centers on patient-facing tools like portals and mobile apps that help individuals manage their health. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: What is an important role of the nurse regarding consumer health informatics and patients?

options.A: Guiding patients to interpret online health information critically and avoid misinformation
options.B: Banning patients from using mobile health applications
options.C: Entering all patient social media passwords into the EHR
options.D: Creating commercial mobile apps for technology companies

explanation: Nurses help patients navigate health information, promoting health literacy and helping them filter out misleading online advice. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: What is a major challenge facing the adoption of nursing informatics in some Nigerian healthcare facilities?

options.A: Erratic power supply and infrastructural deficits
options.B: An overabundance of advanced computer systems
options.C: A complete lack of patients needing hospital care

explanation: Infrastructural challenges such as erratic power supply and limited connectivity often hinder smooth informatics adoption in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)

question: Why is digital competency considered essential for modern nursing students in Nigeria?

options.A: Future trends like telemedicine and AI are redefining nursing practice
options.B: Paper charting has been completely outlawed worldwide
options.C: Nurses will no longer need clinical bedside skills
options.D: Computers will perform all nursing assessments automatically

explanation: Emerging trends like telemedicine, AI, and EHRs mean digital literacy is vital for modern clinical practice and career readiness. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)
